fields.label: Descripción
fields.default: When performing a wall eject as Naoe near the western rooftops of Himeji Castle, the character may become suspended in mid-air while the falling animation continues to loop. Player movement is disabled, but the pause menu remains accessible.

fields.label: Precondiciones
fields.default: Load the synthetic QA save at Himeji Castle. Naoe is selected, the adjacent roof is streamed in, and no combat encounter is active.

fields.label: Pasos (uno por línea)
fields.default:
Launch the title using build 1.0.0.1842.
Load QA_Himeji_Naoe_WestRoof_04.sav.
Select Naoe as the playable character.
Climb the western exterior wall of Himeji Castle.
Perform a wall eject toward the adjacent rooftop while holding the movement stick forward.
Observe the character animation and position.

fields.label: Resultado actual
fields.default: Naoe remains suspended in mid-air with a looping falling animation. Movement inputs have no effect.

fields.label: Resultado esperado
fields.default: Naoe should complete the wall eject, land on the adjacent rooftop, and regain normal movement control.

fields.label: Impacto
fields.default: Traversal is blocked until the checkpoint is reloaded. Pause and menus remain usable.

fields.label: Alternativa temporal
fields.default: Reload the last checkpoint to restore normal gameplay.

fields.label: Notas adicionales
fields.default:
Reproduced in 4 out of 5 attempts.
Not reproduced when performing the same action with Yasuke.
No crash or application termination observed.

fields.label: Keywords
fields.help: Mínimo 3 keywords únicas; no deben repetirse en el cuerpo del ticket. Prueba crash para activar los diagnósticos.

fields.label: Documentar accesibilidad
fields.help: Activa la captura de ajustes de accesibilidad y su resultado esperado.

fields.label: Traza de red
fields.help: Nombre de evidencia simulada; no sube archivos.

fields.label: Log específico del crash
fields.help: Se exige al seleccionar Crash o detectar una mención positiva en el ticket. Es un nombre de evidencia ficticia.
fields.regexMsg: Usa un nombre de archivo .log o .txt sin rutas.

fields.label: Dump del crash (PC)

fields.label: Nombres de adjuntos
fields.help: Referencias ficticias para el output. El panel Media genera nombres; estos campos no adjuntan archivos.

values.shortDescription: Naoe becomes stuck in falling animation after performing a wall eject near Himeji Castle
values.description: When performing a wall eject as Naoe near the western rooftops of Himeji Castle, the character may become suspended in mid-air while the falling animation continues to loop. Player movement is disabled, but the pause menu remains accessible.
values.preconditions: Load the synthetic QA save at Himeji Castle. Naoe is selected, the adjacent roof is streamed in, and no combat encounter is active.
values.reproSteps:
Launch the title using build 1.0.0.1842.
Load QA_Himeji_Naoe_WestRoof_04.sav.
Select Naoe as the playable character.
Climb the western exterior wall of Himeji Castle.
Perform a wall eject toward the adjacent rooftop while holding the movement stick forward.
Observe the character animation and position.
values.actual: Naoe remains suspended in mid-air with a looping falling animation. Movement inputs have no effect.
values.expected: Naoe should complete the wall eject, land on the adjacent rooftop, and regain normal movement control.
values.impact: Traversal is blocked until the checkpoint is reloaded. Pause and menus remain usable.
values.workaround: Reload the last checkpoint to restore normal gameplay.
values.additionalInfo:
Reproduced in 4 out of 5 attempts.
Not reproduced when performing the same action with Yasuke.
No crash or application termination observed.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.shortDescription: Application crash after fast travel with an active smoke effect
values.description: The application terminates during destination streaming when a smoke effect remains active in the departure scene.
values.preconditions: Load the synthetic castle save with a smoke effect spawned. Keep the test rig offline.
values.reproSteps:
Load the QA smoke-effect save.
Spawn the smoke effect beside the west gate.
Fast travel to the harbor training route.
Observe application termination during loading.
values.actual: Application exits to the desktop before destination load completes.
values.expected: The destination loads and the player regains control.
values.impact: Session ends; unsaved progress since the last checkpoint is lost.
values.workaround: Wait for the smoke effect to finish before fast travel.
values.additionalInfo: Reproduced only on the synthetic PC rig. Console control runs complete normally.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.shortDescription: Frame rate drops below target in the rainy Kyoto market
values.description: Dense crowds and rain cause sustained frame pacing degradation during the market route.
values.preconditions: Load the synthetic Kyoto stress save. Use Performance mode and rain.
values.reproSteps:
Load the Kyoto stress save.
Start a profiler capture.
Run through the northern market for 60 seconds.
Record FPS and frame time p95.
values.actual: The synthetic capture averages 24.5 FPS with 40.8 ms frame time p95.
values.expected: The 60 FPS target should be maintained within the test budget.
values.impact: Camera movement and traversal feedback become uneven.
values.workaround: Use the smaller courtyard route for the remaining test pass.
values.additionalInfo: Quality mode is a separate control run. No crash observed.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.shortDescription: Operator position desynchronizes after the round transition
values.description: The operator appears at the previous round position on the observer client after a simulated packet-loss interval.
values.preconditions: Use two synthetic QA clients in a custom match. Apply a controlled 2.5% loss profile.
values.reproSteps:
Start a custom match on Clubhouse.
Select Hibana and reach the CCTV room.
Enable the synthetic packet-loss profile.
Advance to round 3.
Compare player and observer positions.
values.actual: Observer position remains stale for several seconds.
values.expected: Both clients agree on the operator position after the round transition.
values.impact: Observer state does not represent the active player.
values.workaround: Reconnect the observer client between test rounds.
values.additionalInfo: The zero-loss control run passes. No crash observed.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.shortDescription: Arabic briefing text clips at the right edge of the objective panel
values.description: The synthetic Arabic objective label exceeds the briefing panel bounds when subtitle scaling is enabled.
values.preconditions: Select ar-SA and use the QA briefing save with large subtitles.
values.reproSteps:
Load the briefing save.
Open the objective panel.
Select Arabic and large subtitles.
Inspect the panel right edge.
values.actual: The final words of the objective label are clipped.
values.expected: The objective wraps and remains fully legible.
values.impact: Part of the navigation instruction is unreadable.
values.workaround: Use the default text size during this synthetic test.
values.additionalInfo: Japanese and Spanish controls wrap correctly. No crash observed.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.shortDescription: Docking confirmation ignores the remapped hold action
values.description: The docking prompt continues to listen for the default input binding after a custom hold binding is configured.
values.preconditions: Connect a synthetic adaptive-controller profile and remap the docking action.
values.reproSteps:
Load the docking save.
Enable hold interaction and remap confirm.
Approach the relay dock.
Hold the new confirm control.
values.actual: The prompt remains active and docking does not complete.
values.expected: Docking completes using the selected binding.
values.impact: The configured interaction cannot be completed.
values.workaround: Restore the default binding for this test step.
values.additionalInfo: Normal controller defaults complete the action. No crash observed.
values.accessibilityExpected: The remapped hold action should confirm docking without requiring the original button.
values.demoNotice: FICTIONAL QA DEMO. Original synthetic report inspired by public game settings. Not an internal Ubisoft ticket or leaked template. Builds, coordinates, saves, logs and attachment names are invented.

values.verificationResult: All five synthetic attempts land correctly and restore player movement. Yasuke control pass also succeeds.
